    Thinness of the graded covering category #

    Lemma 4.8, first part (lem:lifted-projective-evaluation): "Height gives End_L(x) = k. By Lemma 4.7, every full subcategory on two objects is representation-finite. It is directed. Every subspace of its nonidentity morphism space is an ideal. By Lemma 3.1(1), there are only finitely many such ideals. A space of dimension at least two would have infinitely many lines, so that morphism space has dimension at most one."

    Height is a homomorphism hgt : G → ℤ such that nonzero homogeneous morphisms have nonnegative height, and those of height zero are scalar multiples of identities in degree one (HeightData).

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
